caption:
Monday never comes. Today does. 🏋️

Day 1, same goal. One lifts the smallest weight. One waits for Monday. Day 30, the weight wins. He lifts again. Heavier. A year later: 120 kg. The other missed 52 Mondays.

Send this to someone starting on Monday.

#gym #discipline #fitness #motivation #selfimprovement
